chapter.heading: Hurry, O LORD, to Help Me!(Psalms 40:1–17; Psalms 141:1–10)For the choirmaster. Of David. To bring remembrance.
chapter.v:
Make haste,
O God, to deliver me!Hurry, O LORD, to help me!

May those
who seek my lifebe ashamed and confounded;may those who wish me harmbe repelled and humiliated.

May those
who say, “Aha, aha!”retreat because of their shame.

May all
who seek Yourejoice and be glad in You;may those who love Your salvation always say,“Let God be magnified!”

But I
am poor and needy;hurry to me, O God.You are my help and my deliverer;O LORD, do not delay.
